name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Between Boris and Vera, one goes with 1344 and the other with 1394.
1344 goes with none of Anatoly, Benoni, or Caro-Kann.
Either 1294 goes with Vera or 1394 goes with Boris.
Exactly one of these is true: Anatoly goes with Caro-Kann; Anatoly goes with 1394; Vera goes with 1344.
